tools.name: create_song
tools.description: Make an original instrumental song from a description: genre, mood, instruments, tempo, what it's for. Returns it queued; the player in the chat shows it rendering and plays it when it's done (about a minute), with MP3 and WAV downloads and its five stems (drums, bass, guitar, keys, other) as FLAC.

tools.name: get_song
tools.description: Where a song made with create_song stands: its place in line, or, once done, each version's MP3 and WAV links and its five stems' FLAC links (a few seconds after the mix), and any part being made again with redo_stem.

tools.name: redo_stem
tools.description: Make one stem of a finished song again (new drums, say), with the other four exactly as they are; the mix becomes the new part with the rest. Counts as one song. Takes about a minute; the player shows it. undo_stem puts the old part back.

tools.name: undo_stem
tools.description: Put a song's version back to how it was before its last redo_stem: the old part plays again, and the mix with it. Costs nothing. Only the last redo can be undone.

tools.name: list_songs
tools.description: The songs on the person's Daydream account, newest first: each one's id, words, length, tempo and how many versions. Use get_song with an id to play one.

tools.name: get_songs_left
tools.description: How many songs the person has made this month and how many they can make (no limit on some accounts), and when the count starts again.
